Local OCR Passport Extractor for passport-field extraction with local Ollama VLMs and optional PaddleOCR in default no-template mode.

Primary docs
- README.md
- AGENTS.md

Key paths
- pages/passport-extractor.js: main UI
- pages/api/passport-extractor.js: API route for health, detect, extract
- scripts/paddle_ocr.py: optional PaddleOCR subprocess
- requirements.txt: Python OCR dependencies
- .env.example: runtime env variables
- styles/passport-extractor.css: route styling

Runtime
- Next.js pages router
- Frontend route: /passport-extractor
- API route: POST /api/passport-extractor
- Template storage: browser localStorage key pe_templates

Modes
- health
- detect
- extract

Hard boundaries
- Keep repo focused on passport extraction
- Keep template mode VLM-only
- Allow PaddleOCR only for default no-template extraction
- Do not commit .env.local, .venv, node_modules, .next, or secrets

Validation
- npm run build
- curl POST /api/passport-extractor mode=health
- optional: .venv/bin/python scripts/paddle_ocr.py --health
